measurement_rules: Do not infer reused tokens from final tokens_cached residency.
Do not sum overlapping contact latencies as episode or campaign wall time.
Episode wall time requires original explicit episode boundaries;if absent report unavailable rather than reconstructing from contact sums.
Do not interpret client-minus-server duration as queue time.
Preserve raw output and original official score;no post-hoc score replay.
primary: Official pooled SLU-F1,intent and reliable completion for all repeats
Generation dispatch wall time and complete flight wall time with separate boundaries
Per-role and per-stage input/reused/evaluated/generated tokens,prefill/decode/client transport mean,p50,p95 with missingness
Role/control errors,normalizer use,extra contacts and revisions
secondary: Natural-mixture and equal-stratum summaries with actual support
Layout contrasts within each scheduler,scheduler contrasts within each layout,and their difference as descriptive interaction
Per-variant A/A spread and first-contact versus subsequent-contact costs
analysis.selection: Root reviews complete evidence and selects a feasible measured quality/cost tradeoff or retains the seed. No precommitted score threshold,no global-optimum or stable-benefit claim from20. Cache hits are not an eligibility floor.

latest_owner_timing_priority.distinct_metrics: Batch/dispatch wall divided by sample count and throughput remain distinct from mean sample elapsed time; never substitute summed contacts
latest_owner_timing_priority.first_vs_rest: Report first sample separately; preserve admission/dispatch order and every original start/end timestamp
latest_owner_timing_priority.first_wave: Report first4 concurrent starts versus remaining16 separately; do not silently exclude first wave
latest_owner_timing_priority.prerequisite: Root shared original episode timing instrumentation integrated and identical in all8 frozen members; no worker freeze before that source
latest_owner_timing_priority.primary: Actual original per-sample wall duration mean over samples2-20; report mean over all20 alongside it

optional_timing: Use existing export_system_node_timing under exact complete-family READ. Original episode wall boundaries required; otherwise unavailable.
order_limit: Symmetric position balances linear time trend only. Cache history and numerical batching effects remain; no flush,warmup,save/restore or service changes. Report first versus later contacts and both repeats.
raw_request_audit: Every original contact/body/FIT/control hash; before-speech additionally shared original ORG layout audit; actual requested slot identities for role-affinity
read_gate: All eight independently FINALIZED,verified seals,one unique successful complete official score each,zero failed jobs,then exact root READ. No partial quality or optimizer export.
scores: Exactly one official complete score per member; no failures or replay
source_rule: No earlier update3 role annotations or old scored rows enter this new family.
